info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Account Statements-spec
info.description: The Account Statements Retrieval API allows users to access statement information for specific customer accounts. By providing the customer ID and account ID, consumers can retrieve detailed financial statements, which are crucial for customers' financial management and analysis. This API is typically utilized by banking applications, financial advisors, and accounting software to facilitate transparency in account activities. Developers can integrate this functionality into their platforms, enabling end-users to easily monitor their transactions and account performance.

get.summary: Retrieve the account statement for a specific customer account.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the detailed statement of a specific account belonging to a customer. It provides insights into transactions, balances, and other relevant financial information, facilitating better account management and review.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the statement information for a specific account belonging to a particular customer. The data returned includes transaction history and account details necessary for generating financial statements.

200.description: The account statement was retrieved successfully.

ListAccountStatementsRequest.description: Represents the request body for the GET operation to retrieve the statement of an account.

ListAccountStatementsResponse_200.title: Statement Response

value.description: The value of the statement, represented as a string.

metadata.description: Metadata related to the response, providing additional information.

ListAccountStatementsResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response of a statement operation for a specific customer and account.

ResponseMetadata.title: Response Metadata

correlationId.description: Identifier used to correlate requests and responses.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region where the processing of the request took place.

ResponseMetadata.description: Schema representing metadata information for a response.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: Identifies the endpoint for which the response applies. This value is crucial for tracking requests across different services.

X-Runtime-App.description: Specifies the name of the application that processed the request. Useful for debugging and monitoring application performance.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses HTTP Bearer Authentication. A JSON Web Token (JWT) must be provided in the Authorization header to authenticate requests. The format for the token is specified as 'Bearer {token}'.
